name: Inactive Autologout
project_description:
The Inactive Autologout module allows site administrators to log out users automatically after a specified period of inactivity. It features a user-friendly interface where administrators can configure the inactivity timeout and enable settings based on user roles.

 Key features:

 
 Customizable Timeout: Easily set inactivity durations to suit your site's requirements. 
 Role-Based Settings: Apply inactivity rules to specific roles for greater flexibility and control. 
 Lightweight and Efficient: Designed to minimize performance overhead, ensuring seamless integration with your site. 
 
 This module is an excellent solution for improving site security and user management while maintaining optimal performance.
